description.value: A family-run private campground on the Kettle River east of Grand Forks, with flush showers, a sandy beach, and paved/easy access just 5 km off Highway 3; the Trans-Canada Trail runs directly from camp.

address.value: 1285 Manly Meadows Rd, Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a year-round campground on the Kettle River east of Grand Forks with both RV and tent sites, showers, free Wi-Fi, a camp store, ice, and explicit cycling encouragement ('Bring Your Bikes' section citing Trans-Canada Trail access). OSM tag internet_access=no contradicts the website's prominent 'Free Wireless Internet' and 'high-speed internet' claims — website is more authoritative here. Reservations confirmed via both OSM (reservation=yes) and the website's booking page with phone/email. Address and phone come from the website as OSM has neither.
concerns: OSM tag internet_access=no contradicts website which prominently advertises free Wi-Fi throughout the campground; website is likely current
OSM has no phone or address fields to cross-check; values sourced from website only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Year-round campground with tent sites, showers, and explicit cycling encouragement near the Trans-Canada Trail — strong fit for touring cyclists on the southern BC corridor.
